question: Is direction D001 already explored or contradicted: Narrow the contribution to what survives the overlap: (a) a retrieval-agnostic temporal relevance layer whose temporal signal is valid-time (as-of) membership rather than elapsed-time decay, (b) evaluated as a base-retriever x signal-form factorial (BM25, dense, hybrid) with a version-level contamination metric as a primary outcome and queries deliberately decoupled from recency, and (c) a version-level benchmark of amended statutes/regulations with near-duplicate successive versions and ground-truth in-force clauses. Drop the claims that temporal decay, temporal validity, or architecture-agnostic treatment are themselves novel, and drop answer accuracy as the sole success criterion.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
